notes: DBNL marks the underlying historical work Auteursrechtvrij.
The online text is a diplomatic rendering with omissions and a published list of editorial corrections; inspect a page image for date or typographic claims.
Colophon corrections relevant to this project: p. 7 '1565 -> 1665', p. 84 '1664 -> 1674' (II. Hert-sterckte), p. 87 '1664 -> 1674' ('t Verheven Herte).
Copy transcribed: Universiteitsbibliotheek Amsterdam 113: BALIE 250.D12. Images used by DBNL come from Koninklijke Bibliotheek Den Haag 4 B 1.
A downloadable scan bundle is advertised at https://www.dbnl.org/arch/lode002uyt_01_01/pag/lode002uyt_01_01.pdf but was not acquired in this pass.

songbooks.title: Bloemlezing uit de bundel Uytspanningen — selection containing II. Hert-sterckte
notes: Edited by P.J. Buijnsters; a later selection, not the 1674 manuscript or the whole 1676 volume.
Its headnote describes four consolation songs written during the 1673 hostage period and printed by the poet himself in 1674 as 'Meditatien over eenige van 's Heeren Gods Eygenschappen'.
Its footnote on II. Hert-sterckte states 'Er staat abusievelijk: 1664', i.e. that the print reads 1664; the date remains on EVIDENCE_HOLD until the 1676 leaf is inspected.

songbooks.title: Uytspanningen, behelsende eenige stichtelyke liederen, en andere gedichten
notes: An independent later typesetting of the same collection, used for collation.
It prints II. Hert-sterckte with the date '4 in Loumaand 1674' on printed p. 84, and keeps the internal tune pointer 'siet boven pag. 29' with the same pagination.
As a later edition it may descend from a corrected copy: it corroborates but does not prove what the 1676 compositor set.

songbooks.title: Meditatien over eenige van 's Heeren Gods Eygenschappen
notes: The poet's own separate printing of the four exiled Rees hymns, described by two modern sources.
Not acquired: no copy, catalogue record or page image is held.
Collating it against the 1676 printing is the strongest available test of the group's dating.
